name: clawd-presence
description: Shows your Claude Code sessions as a Discord activity, with an animated Clawd and a short summary of what you are working on.

summary.title: Work summary / Résumé du travail
summary.description: Show a short summary of your last two messages (made with Claude Haiku, uses a little of your plan). Visible to everyone who sees your Discord profile.

client_id.title: Discord application ID
client_id.description: Leave as is, or put the ID of your own Discord application to change the name shown after "Playing".
